name: Teshio (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Teshio town emblem in white and orange: a white broken ring of arcs enclosing an orange six-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Teshio, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1950.

features.role: Teshio town emblem — a white broken ring of arcs enclosing an orange six-pointed star
